provenanceLimits: All downloaded artifact bytes and lengths are SHA256 pinned. Debian snapshot SHA1-addressed downloads were also checked against snapshot metadata during acquisition; each .dsc SHA256 table covers every included source component.

Debian .dsc signatures and Node SHASUMS256.txt.asc are retained but signer trust, revocation, and signatures were not independently authenticated. SHA256 equality and HTTPS acquisition are not a signature-verification claim.

The candidate Node binary and LICENSE match the official v24.21.0 linux-x64 distribution verified against SHASUMS256.txt. Its LICENSE also matches the exact official source tarball. This is identity verification, not a reproducible-build attestation.

Installed Debian metadata identifies source versions. The GCC binaries here report gcc-14 14.2.0-19; no compiler-version-derived revision was substituted. zlib1g binary 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+b1 explicitly names source version 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1, preserving its epoch and excluding the binary-only rebuild suffix.

The generator carries complete upstream/Debian build scripts and an allowlisted service snapshot but does not vendor every build dependency or promise bit-identical binaries. Original licenses and notices govern; this is not a legal opinion.
